meta.name: saucedemo_checkout
meta.description: Log in as standard_user with password secret_sauce, then add the first product (Sauce Labs Backpack) to the cart, open the shopping cart, click Checkout, fill the shipping form (First Name 'John', Last Name 'Doe', Zip/Postal Code '73112'), click Continue, then Finish to reach the order-complete confirmation page.

target.name: Username
target.reasoning: Type the username into the Username field before entering the password.

target.name: Password
target.reasoning: Username is already filled; next enter the password into the password field.

assertion.expect: The password field contains the entered password and the Login button is ready to be clicked.

target.name: Login
target.reasoning: Credentials are filled; click Login to authenticate.

assertion.expect: Products page with inventory list visible

target.name: Add to cart
target.reasoning: The first product is Sauce Labs Backpack; its Add to cart button is index 5. Click it to add to cart.

assertion.expect: Cart badge updates to 1 and the button changes to Remove for Sauce Labs Backpack

target.name: Cart, 1 items
target.reasoning: The first product is already in the cart (cart shows 1 item, and the Backpack has a Remove button). Next step is to open the shopping cart.

assertion.expect: Shopping cart page opens showing Sauce Labs Backpack in the cart.

target.name: Checkout
target.reasoning: The cart page shows the Sauce Labs Backpack and a Checkout button. The next step is to click Checkout to proceed to the shipping form.

assertion.expect: Checkout: Your Information form should be displayed with First Name, Last Name, and Zip/Postal Code fields.

target.name: First Name
target.reasoning: Fill in the shipping form. Start by typing the first name into the First Name field.

target.name: Last Name
target.reasoning: We are on checkout step one; first name already filled. Next fill Last Name field.

target.name: Zip/Postal Code
target.reasoning: The first and last name are already filled. The next required step is to enter the Zip/Postal Code before clicking Continue.

target.name: Continue
target.reasoning: Shipping form is filled. Click Continue to proceed to order overview.

assertion.expect: Order overview page with Finish button visible

target.name: Finish
target.reasoning: On the checkout overview page, click Finish to place the order and reach the confirmation page.

assertion.expect: Order complete confirmation page with thank you message and order details
